frozen_relation.statement: The external dimensional record contains the 7/5-solar-mass electron-degenerate limit. The independently measured neutral-fermion-supported PSR J0740 mass interval is [201/100,215/100] solar masses, wholly above 7/5. The conditional merger-remnant upper records 267/100 and 61/20 solar masses are both above that measured interval and remain explicitly model-assisted rather than direct TOV measurements. Together with the earlier horizon-scale shadow/ringdown receipt, the post-seal record supports the ordered finite white-dwarf, neutron-star and horizon-endpoint classes. No direct astrophysical Hawking-radiation or temperature measurement exists in the registered vector, so the exact mT=1/16 law remains an unconfirmed, falsifiable prediction rather than a rewarded absence.
